On August 20, Meta announced that it had stopped hiring in its AI division after bringing in more than 50 AI re… Meta Platforms (META) Ends AI Hiring Push Following Huge Capital Expenditure. Meta Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ:META) is placed 3rd on our list of the best stocks to buy. On August 20, Meta announced that it had stopped hiring in its AI division after bringing in more than 50 AI researchers and engineers over the past few months. The hiring freeze started last week and is part of a bigger restructuring in Meta’s AI division. The changes also prevent current employees from moving between teams within the division. There is no clear timeline for the end of the freeze. Meta (META) Ends AI Hiring Push Following Huge Capital Expenditure Photo by Shutter Speed on Unsplash Earlier this year, Meta went on a big AI hiring push, offering nine-figure salaries to lure talent from major AI companies like OpenAI. The company also reportedly used reverse acquihires to take key staff from start-ups. Meta has reorganized its AI division into four teams, including one focused on superintelligence. Zuckerberg personally led efforts to recruit top talent from OpenAI, Google, Apple, and AI startups, even offering huge sums to lure them in. The company is seen as one of Wall Street’s “AI Hyperscalers”, a group of big tech firms investing massive amounts into AI development and data centers. Meta alone has set aside around $72 billion for AI this year. However, this heavy spending has worried investors, who are concerned that higher costs and generous stock-based compensation could hurt profits. While we acknowledge the potential of META as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. If you're looking for an extremely undervalued AI stock that also stands to benefit significantly from Trump-era tariffs and the onshoring trend, see our free report on the best short-term AI stock. raw_articles.title: Buy META Stock Over Amazon?
raw_articles.full_text: Buy META Stock Over Amazon?. Why buy Amazon stock (NASDAQ: AMZN) at 38 times earnings when Meta stock (NASDAQ: META) trades at a lower multiple of 29?. ANKARA, TURKIYE - NOVEMBER 14: In this photo illustration, logo of 'Amazon' is displayed on a mobile phone screen in front of the logo of ''Meta'' in Ankara, Turkiye on November 14, 2023. (Photo by Y… Buy META Stock Over Amazon?. ANKARA, TURKIYE - NOVEMBER 14: In this photo illustration, logo of 'Amazon' is displayed on a mobile phone screen in front of the logo of ''Meta'' in Ankara, Turkiye on November 14, 2023. (Photo by Yasin Baturhan Ergin/Anadolu via Getty Images) Anadolu via Getty Images Question: Why buy Amazon stock (NASDAQ: AMZN) at 38 times earnings when Meta stock (NASDAQ: META) trades at a lower multiple of 29? You likely wouldn’t, especially after considering these straightforward points: Growth: Meta’s revenue is expanding far more quickly than Amazon’s. Over the last twelve months, Meta's revenue has grown by over 19%, nearly double Amazon's growth rate of around 10%, highlighting a faster pace of expansion at Meta. Margins: Meta's profit margins of over 42% are well above Amazon's operating margin of around 11%. In practice, a larger share of every new revenue dollar at Meta converts to profit, suggesting superior shareholder value potential from its growth. Financial Position: Meta’s balance sheet is stronger, reflecting more conservative leverage and greater liquidity. Meta’s debt-to-equity ratio is 2.7%, versus Amazon’s 5.5%, indicating less reliance on debt. Meta also carries a higher cash-to-assets ratio of 25.1% compared to Amazon’s 13.7%, implying more liquid resources relative to total assets. Now, if you want upside with less volatility than a single stock, consider the High Quality Portfolio. It has comfortably outperformed its benchmark—a blend of the S&P 500, Russell, and S&P MidCap indexes—and has delivered returns exceeding 91% since inception. Separately, see – Buy Or Fear Oracle Stock At $220? META Is Uniquely Positioned to Capitalize on the AI Revolution Meta Platforms presents a compelling opportunity for investors bullish on long-term AI adoption, regardless of tariff dynamics. Its edge stems from a dual role: it both builds advanced AI and deploys it immediately across an ecosystem that reaches billions of users. Rather than stopping at R&D, Meta rapidly applies these tools to improve ads, personalize content, and lift engagement—accelerating monetization. With heavy investment in AI research and a unique platform for instant rollout, Meta is positioned to capture the benefits of future AI advances. Related – Meta Platforms: Doubling Down On AI And Advertising. In the second quarter of 2025, Meta reported strong results that reflected its focus on efficiency and AI-driven execution. Revenue exceeded expectations, led by resilient advertising, as ongoing improvements in targeting and measurement—powered by Meta’s AI stack—continued to pay off. Moreover, the company’s net margins improved meaningfully. Disciplined cost control and operating leverage from scaling AI infrastructure helped drive higher profitability alongside robust top-line growth, underscoring the payoff from its AI investments. MORE FOR YOU Potential Risks to Consider A key risk is a potential slowdown in revenue growth.
